text:
Tessa Olivary you would have 45 days to send the missing documents. If you don't make it within that time line you would have to ask for extra time (they don't have to approve it).
If you are too late your file gets closed and you would have to start again.
It happened to us , although they allowed us to reopen it with the same documents two months later. But this was during corona so don't assume you could as well.
